The new booked rate is also strictly above #8070's exact installed family ceiling.

The K7 ordinary factor at the literal floor 18960 fits a debit of 11239/8192 instead of 1405/1024. Transfer one height level from ordinary stage two to Gaussian. The new heights are (8192,124863,524288) and 490639. Gaussian now binds for this profile. The former debit at the new ordinary heights fails, and retaining the former Gaussian height also fails at the new rate. The new factor has directed reserve greater than 0.000062662376093595. Both native widths, owner restorations and the signed caller remain included.
